definitions: Any of various small, deep-sea marine fish of the family Sternoptychidae, having a compressed body and often bioluminescent organs.
Any of various small, freshwater fish of the family Gasteropelecidae, native to Central and South America, having a deep, compressed body and large pectoral fins.
examples: The hatchet fish is known for its bioluminescence.
Many hatchet fish species inhabit the Amazon basin.
Observe the hatchet fish in its natural habitat.
